title: Martin Tigers Band Named KGNS Band of the Week
excerpt: The Martin Tigers band, 'La Banda del Animo,' is KGNS' Band of the Week after earning its 15th straight 1st Division award at the UIL March Fest.
content:
The Martin Tigers band has been named KGNS' Band of the Week, according to KGNS.

The band, known as “La Banda del Animo,” has more than 130 students out this season, according to the report.

The band's drum majors are Carlos Vela, Ana Gonzales and Laura Rivera, according to KGNS.

This season the band is performing “The Rise and Fall of Rome,” a show that takes audiences on a journey through the Roman Empire, according to the report.

The band earned its 15th straight 1st Division award at the recent UIL March Fest, according to KGNS.

Sources: KGNS.
